description: Merge recipes (each at its own servings) and anything else into one shopping list by aisle, in what a store sells (10 cloves garlic → 1 head). Use for "make me a list", "what do I need to buy?" or "add paper towels and 2 lb bananas" (extra_items keep the cook's amounts). What the cook has stays off (left_off); staples and small amounts of bulk items (3 tbsp flour) come back as likely_have, not bought: ask which they have or are out of, then update_shopping_list. Items that hit their allergies are flagged privately for this cook; warnings are not saved in the shareable list. Signed in, the list is saved and returns a shareable url and an id for order_groceries; signed out it comes back unsaved (keep: true asks them to sign in).

extra_items.description: Anything else for the same trip, as the cook said it, amount included: ["paper towels", "2 lb bananas"]. A matching recipe ingredient gets that quantity added when the units agree, or both amounts when they don't.

include_staples.description: Put salt, oil, sugar, etc. on the list instead of the pantry check

keep.description: Older spelling of save: true = save, false = preview. Still works; prefer save

pantry.description: Ingredients the cook already has, e.g. ["flour", "eggs"]

request_key.description: Your own id or receipt.request_key. First save wins for this cook and tool: within 10 minutes the same key returns the saved list, even if arguments changed. New arguments need a new key; edits use update_*. Without a key Befana fingerprints arguments and applied preferences/pantry

save.description: "preview": show the list and keep nothing (no id, no url, nothing in My Kitchen), signed in or out; use it when the cook says "just show me", "don't save it yet", "an option". "save": keep it in the cook's kitchen (signed out: the sign-in error). Left out: a signed-in call saves, a signed-out call previews. The receipt in the result says which happened

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.
